claim_ceiling: Reproduction and extension of the published Swarm Cooperation Model (SCM) on low-dimensional static/dynamic optimization landscapes and simulated AUV contaminant localization; not a universal collective-intelligence metric or physical sea-trial evidence

publication.title: A collective intelligence model for swarm robotics applications
publication.article_license: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 as shown on article record; this article licence does not automatically grant rights to separate MATLAB source code or third-party datasets.

zenodo_release.rights_metadata: The inspected Zenodo Rights field did not expose a license value.

software_license.note: The repository has no visible root LICENSE or LICENSE.txt. No MATLAB source was copied to this project. A clean-room independent implementation from the published mathematical description may be considered after exact equation ambiguity is resolved and legal/provenance review is recorded.

static_low_dimensional_landscape_suite.dimensions: 2D and 3D for analytical landscapes; fractal only 2D
static_low_dimensional_landscape_suite.stochastic_processes: 100 different Wiener processes for SCM and PSO
static_low_dimensional_landscape_suite.success_definition: Final swarm centroid within 0.05 * L of the true global optimum
static_low_dimensional_landscape_suite.reported_comparison: SCM success rate >= PSO/MIPA on 22 of 33 low-dimensional cases
static_low_dimensional_landscape_suite.cost_tradeoff: About one order of magnitude more function evaluations overall; SCM function evaluations significantly higher on 24 of 33 cases
static_low_dimensional_landscape_suite.reporting: Success rate, mean function evaluations and standard deviation of function evaluations are distinct metrics.

auv_dynamic_contaminant_localization.limitation: Simulated hydrodynamics and AUV vehicle dynamics; not a physical fleet experiment.

initialization.semantics: When the circle-packing file exists, the eight initial positions are the listed deterministic coordinates shifted by +0.5 in each coordinate. It is not a fresh random initial state per replication in this driver.

source_replication_driver.noise_seed_law: For replication nr (1-based), agent i (1-based) and dimension j (1-based), rng seed = 2*i + M*(j-1) + nr - 1; draw a standard-normal vector of length por.nts for that agent and dimension.
source_replication_driver.caution: This default reproduction script is not necessarily the exact driver for every paper figure/table. Preserve source protocol and Supplementary Dataset 1–3 independently.

model_definition.agent_state: continuous position vector x_k in a bounded unit domain
model_definition.fitness_term: gradient of locally perceived scalar fitness
model_definition.fitness_weight: inverse of swarm-mean L2 norm of the fitness gradient as described in the article
model_definition.adaptive_noise: agent-dependent noise factor lambda_k times global sigma(t), driven by consensus trend
model_definition.agent_communication: full network exchange of agent position, perceived fitness and gradient
model_definition.memory: agents do not retain a global best-known position; paper identifies this as static-landscape tradeoff and possible dynamic-landscape benefit

equation_consistency_audit.significance: These are different interaction kernels and change the numerical dynamics. A source-faithful result must not select a variant silently.
required_resolution: Inspect the supplementary-information pseudocode and derivation.
Confirm which kernel was used to produce Supplementary Datasets 1–3.
Request author clarification if publication equation and release source remain inconsistent.
Until then, keep PaperEquation and RepositoryCode kernels separately tagged in an independent Rust reference.

implementation_risks_and_challenges: Zero mean gradient makes xi = 1 / mean(||gradient||) undefined or non-finite.
Coincident agents make maximum pairwise distance Dmax = 0 in lambda_k = d_k/(Dmax*C).
Fitness-weighted centroid behavior near equal or degenerate fitness values requires tests.
Out-of-domain agent recovery uses a conical continuation and zero assigned landscape fitness; reproduce this exactly before comparing.
Consensus-window difference I near zero can destabilize the global sigma update; test finite clamps and exact source semantics.
The all-to-all communication assumption should be stressed with delay, bandwidth, packet loss and stale-state regimes.
Fixed circle-packing initialization and stochastic seed protocol must match the chosen paper table/figure.

oli_benchmark_design.anti_leakage: Keep entire random processes, environment realizations and initial conditions within one split. Time windows from one trajectory are not independent trials.
oli_benchmark_design.improvement_target: At equal success probability and equal safety envelope, reduce total sensor/function evaluations or energy-distance cost by >=20% on at least two source-reproduced benchmark strata; alternatively improve success rate by >=5 percentage points at equal total cost. Proposed target only, not achieved.
oli_benchmark_design.second_target: On dynamic environments, improve median peak-relocalization lag by >=20% versus source SCM at matched vehicle count, sensing rate and communications budget, with no increase in mission abort rate. Proposed target only.
oli_benchmark_design.report_pareto: Publish success-vs-cost Pareto frontiers; do not hide SCM's evaluation-cost tradeoff in one scalar.
